syn:large:text.description: Recommended - Synthetic's "large:text" convenience alias for deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, described by the vendor as "an efficient near-Fable model with vision." Despite the `:text` suffix it accepts image input (input_modalities: text, image, per the live roster). 512K context, 64K max output. Per unauthenticated GET https://api.synthetic.new/openai/v1/models (2026-09-28, HTTP 200): supported_features = tools, json_mode, structured_outputs, reasoning; reasoning_parameters.efforts = none/low/high/xhigh/max. Pricing (converted from the roster's per-token USD rates): $0.60 / $1.20 per MTok input/output, $0.03 per MTok cached input. Also reachable via the underlying weights id hf:deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash (same model, same pricing) — see that catalog entry. Not itself capability-probed with a live key; this is a roster+docs verified entry (see evidence.liveMatrix: null).

syn:small:text.description: Synthetic's "small:text" convenience alias for zai-org/GLM-4.7-Flash — the smaller, faster sibling in the ~30B-parameter class, text-only input (no image modality on the live roster). Consumes rate limits more slowly per the vendor's own description. 192K context, 64K max output. supported_features = tools, json_mode, structured_outputs, reasoning (live roster GET, 2026-09-28). Pricing: $0.10 / $0.50 per MTok input/output, $0.02 per MTok cached input. Also reachable via hf:zai-org/GLM-4.7-Flash (same model). Roster+docs verified only; no live key probe.

syn:large:vision.description: Synthetic's "large:vision" convenience alias for moonshotai/Kimi-K3, described by the vendor as "a massive 2.8T-parameter open-source model ... [that] supports vision on uploaded images." 512K context, 64K max output. supported_features = tools, json_mode, structured_outputs, reasoning (live roster GET, 2026-09-28). Pricing: $3.00 / $15.00 per MTok input/output, $0.45 per MTok cached input — the most expensive model in this roster. Also reachable via hf:moonshotai/Kimi-K3 (same model). Roster+docs verified only; no live key probe.

syn:small:vision.description: Synthetic's "small:vision" convenience alias for Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B — "a small but capable coding and vision model from Qwen" that consumes rate limits less quickly per the vendor. 256K context, 64K max output. supported_features = tools, json_mode, structured_outputs, reasoning (live roster GET, 2026-09-28). Pricing: $0.45 / $2.20 per MTok input/output, $0.09 per MTok cached input. Also reachable via hf:Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B (same model). Roster+docs verified only; no live key probe.

instructions: 1. Visit: https://synthetic.new and choose Sign up (or Log in if you already have an account)
2. Subscribe to a Pack ($1/day or $30/month, 500 requests/5hr per the pricing page) or set up enterprise usage-based billing — Synthetic has no free tier or keyless trial
3. Generate an API key from your account dashboard
setup.description: OpenAI-compatible endpoint at https://api.synthetic.new/openai/v1 (confirmed by both the vendor's own docs and LiteLLM's third-party provider page, which lists /chat/completions as the only supported operation), serving 11 model ids covering 7 unique always-on open-source models (DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, Kimi K3, Qwen 3.8 27B, GLM 5.3 Flash, GLM 4.7 Flash, GPT-OSS-120B, Nemotron-3-Super-120B) under one flat-fee or usage-based subscription. No free tier or keyless trial; billing is a $1/day or $30/month pack (500 req/5hr) or enterprise pay-per-token. The pricing page also lists a separate embeddings model (hf:nomic-ai/nomic-embed-text-v1.5) included in the subscription, but NeuroLink's embeddings capability is not currently wired for Tier-2 catalog providers (only OpenAI, Google AI Studio, Google Vertex and Bedrock embed natively), so capabilities.embeddings is false here regardless of vendor support.

rosterVerified.method: unauthenticated GET https://api.synthetic.new/openai/v1/models — 11 models; credential-free, no key used

billingProbe.method: unauthenticated GET https://synthetic.new/pricing — no free tier; $1/day or $30/month subscription pack (500 req/5hr), or enterprise usage-based pricing; credential-free, no key used
